{{Short description|French mathematician}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2026}}

'''Christophe Gadbled''' (1732{{ndash}}1782) was professor of [[mathematics]] and [[hydrography]] at the [[University of Caen Normandy]].{{sfnp|Simon|1929}}{{sfnp|Frère|1860}}

Gadbled was born in [[Saint-Martin-le-Bouillant]] on 29 November 1732, and died in [[Caen]] on 11 October 1782.{{sfnp|Simon|1929}} Robert Fox describes him as a "modern-minded mathematician",{{sfnp|Fox|2007}} who had a particular influence on [[Pierre-Simon Laplace]].{{sfnp|Simon|1929}}{{sfnp|Fox|2007}}

==Selected works==
* ''Exposé des quelques unes des vérités rigoureusement démontrées par les géomètres et rejetées par l'auteur du "Compendium de physique"'', Caen, 1775
* ''Exercice sur la théorie de la navigation'', Caen, 1779
